name: Sticky Wings
description: Baked chicken wings glazed with a sweet and savory brown sugar and soy sauce mixture.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 300°F.
Break chicken wings apart at the joints and discard tips.
Place wings in a roasting pan and cover with the sauce mixture (brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic salt).
Bake until the sauce evaporates and wings are sticky.

keywords: sticky chicken wings, baked wings, appetizer

_similar.name: Sticky Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish baked in a sticky sauce with pineapple and mushrooms.

recipeInstructions.text: Shake chicken pieces in a bag with flour, paprika, ginger, and garlic powder to coat.
Combine pineapple juice and water to make 1 cup. Add brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, soya sauce, and drained mushrooms. Mix well.
Place the coated chicken in a pan, skin side down. Pour the sauce over the chicken.
Bake at 350°F, uncovered, for 1 hour. Baste often and turn the chicken at 30 minutes.
During the last 5 minutes, add drained pineapple tidbits and an additional can of drained mushrooms.

_similar.keywords: sticky chicken, baked chicken, pineapple chicken

_similar.name: Sweet & Sour Pineapple Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and tangy chicken dish baked in a pineapple-based sauce, perfect for a comforting meal.
recipeIngredient: ⅗ cup (¼ cup + 2 Tbsp) crushed pineapple, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Simmer the chicken breasts in water until cooked through, turning occasionally.
In a pan, combine crushed pineapple, vinegar, brown sugar, salt, ketchup, and water. Cook over heat, stirring until the sauce thickens.
Place the cooked chicken in a casserole dish and pour the sweet and sour sauce over the top.
Cover the dish with tinfoil and bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken

_similar.name: Water Chestnuts Wrapped in Bacon
_similar.description: Bacon-wrapped water chestnuts marinated in a savory mixture of soya sauce and Worcestershire sauce, then baked until crispy.

recipeInstructions.text: Marinate bacon in soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, garlic salt, and minced onions for 1 hour.
Wrap bacon around chestnuts and secure with toothpicks.
Cook in a 350°F oven until bacon is done.

_similar.keywords: bacon-wrapped water chestnuts, appetizer, savory snack

_similar.name: Bacon Wrapped Water Chestnuts
_similar.description: Sweet and savory bacon-wrapped water chestnuts marinated overnight in a mixture of soya sauce and brown sugar.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown bacon and cut in half.
Roll water chestnuts in white sugar, wrap with bacon, and secure with toothpicks.
Mix brown sugar and soya sauce together.
Pour mixture over bacon-wrapped water chestnuts and marinate overnight.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: bacon-wrapped water chestnuts, sweet and savory, appetizer
